description: FAILURE scenario — detects missing SplitN<3 guard. Input path /stock has no trailing segment. strings.SplitN("/stock", "/", 3) yields ["", "stock"] (len=2 < 3). Without the guard, accessing parts[2] would panic (index out of range). With a wrong implementation that returns parts[1] ("/stock") or an empty string, routing is broken. The correct output is "/".

injection.mutated_logic: parts[2] accessed without len check, or returns empty string instead of /
injection.effect: path /stock incorrectly produces panic, empty string, or /stock instead of /

wrong_output_when_bug_injected.panic: runtime error: index out of range [2] with length 2

note: This scenario MUST produce RED when the len(parts)<3 guard is removed. Use as G10/G11 injection fixture for proxy-path-resolver.
